newsitem.title: CYPRUS: CYPRUS GIVES OFFSHORE LICENCE TO VOJVODJANSKA BANK.
newsitem.headline: CYPRUS GIVES OFFSHORE LICENCE TO VOJVODJANSKA BANK.

text.p: The Central Bank of Cyprus on Tuesday granted a licence to Vojvodjanska Banka AD of Yugoslavia to operate from Cyprus on an offshore basis, the bank said.

Vojvodjanska Banka will deal only in foreign currencies and transact business only with other offshore and non-resident companies as well as non-resident persons, the central bank said in a news release.

It added that Vojvodjanska's operations from within Cyprus will be subject to the supervision and inspection of the central bank of Cyprus in addition to the supervision of the Yugoslav banking supervisory authority.

Vojvodjanska recently took over the operations of Kreditna Banka Beograd dd, another Yugoslav bank. The licence given to Vojvodjanska will enable it to assume the operations of Kreditna's Cyprus Offshore Banking Unit which was established in February 1992, the central bank said.

"The presence of Vojvodjanska in Cyprus is another indication of our country's success in attracting international banks and financial institutions and of Cyprus's growing recognition among such institutions as a reputable offshore financial centre," the central bank said.

The licence raises the number of licences granted to foreign banks to operate in Cyprus on an offshore basis to 31. Eight permits have been issued for the establishment of representative offices of foreign banks in Cyprus.
The central bank said other foreign banks have expressed interest in establishing an offshore presence on the island and more banking business licences are expected to be granted in the near future.
